=== Case 5 ===
ISSUE:
Add a way to export a report as CSV. Users want to open reports in a spreadsheet.

FAIL_TO_PASS TESTS:
tests/test_report.py::test_to_csv_writes_header
tests/test_report.py::test_to_csv_amounts_in_cents

--- a/ledger/report.py
+++ b/ledger/report.py
@@ -40,0 +41,6 @@ class Report:
+    def to_csv(self, file):
+        writer = csv.writer(file)
+        writer.writerow(["id", "name", "total_cents"])
+        for row in self.rows:
+            writer.writerow([row.id, row.name, row.total_cents])
